We’re counting down 🥂✨ to an evening of warm hospitality, cold champagne and @tomcolicchio’s final courses of 2025. 

Our sophisticated New Year’s Eve sendoff offers two seatings: 

First Seating, 5-7pm
$155pp 
Dedicated to a three-course menu curated by Tom Colicchio

Second Seating, 8-10pm
$225pp
Pairs four, festive courses with live jazz by the @babysodajazz, and includes party favors + a champagne toast. Second seating guests are invited to keep their seats until 2026. 🎉

Generations of GFS alumni—from the classes of 1966 to 2024—hit NYC for the annual Alumni & Friends Gathering at @craft_newyork in Midtown. Head of School Dana Weeks and Chief Advancement Officer Hannah Henderson '91 shared updates from Coulter Street, and retired science faculty member Gen Nelson reconnected with former students. It was wonderful to celebrate our GFS community where our doors are always open!

🔗 Visit the link in bio to read more about the reunion.

#GermantownFriendsSchool #GermantownFriends #GFSAlumni

A familiar face in the neighborhood, Anita joined our team earlier this year, bringing with her a wealth of experience and an energy that brightens our dining room every day. Stop in, say hello, and catch up with Anita — she’ll be delighted to help make your visit extra special this season. ✨

Happy 3 weeks of being husband and wife. Celebrating at #craftrestaurant in NYC which remains to be the MOST amazing restaurant in every way. That's #chocolatesouffle w/spiced pear #sorbet, #duck a l'orange, and #octopus w/#salsify. We got to meet #ChefTomCollichio. Incredible. I told him I dream about his #glutenfreebread. Not a euphemism. It's THE BEST and they don't charge you. As much as you want. They even packed some to go for me, without my asking. They are so good about #foodallergies there. I really appreciate it.

Thank you for all of your birthday wishes. My wishes came true in every way this year. What a way to celebrate my 55th bday by bringing Chelsea here to start her new life. Thanks to @craft_newyork for a dinner to remember. We will be back. You are incredible.
